howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Three pieces working together: what you draw, what the tutor learns about you, and when it is time to review.

strokes.title: Guided strokes
strokes.text: You draw the character with your finger. The system compares your order and direction, stroke by stroke, against the correct one.
bullets: Official stroke order from open datasets (Make Me a Hanzi).

tutor.title: Adaptive tutor
tutor.text: An AI agent analyzes your history: which characters you often confuse and which kind of stroke you miss most.
bullets: It focuses on exactly what you struggle with, not random lists.
It explains the mistake in plain language.

progress.title: Progress by level
progress.text: You move from HSK 1 to HSK 6. The system models your forgetting curve and decides when to review each character.
bullets: Review right before you forget, not every day.
